notes: Title screen of 359 Scopus records (2021–2026). Journal articles/reviews naming HPP/HPH/ultrasound/PEF/plasma/irradiation/nonthermal in a food context were sought. Public OA PDF or Europe PMC JATS only. Five retrieved files excluded at full text (off-topic, bibliometric-only, unreadable, or wrong document). Gap-fill: Huang et al. 2022 Foods plant-food HPP review retrieved via Europe PMC JATS. Two other OpenAlex hits (Gouvea 2021 Food Res; Stratakos 2021 LWT) had no public PDF/JATS.
